mode: read-only static installed dependency inspection; no launch, imports, OAuth, token/store reads, network model calls or artifact changes

observations.fact: Named routes can select openai-responses. Adapter has scoped credential records, exclusive modify/refresh bridge and native authorization-flow registration. maxRetries0; passes optional temperature and maxTokens. No onPayload override passed in stream call.

Installed built-in openai-codex base URL is https://chatgpt.com/backend-api. This is not the public endpoint documented for the current ChatGPT plan usage flow; built-in OAuth presence does not qualify that flow.

Public Responses request emits stream:true/store:false. max_output_tokens emitted only when maxTokens set and supportsMaxOutputTokens true; temperature emitted whenever provided. Prompt cache retention emitted per compatibility/profile policy.
Leading system prompt becomes developer only for reasoning model with supportsDeveloperRole notfalse; otherwise system. Must pin/qualify actual model/compat and assembled role.

officialSources.finding: OAuth-authorized public api.openai.com/v1/responses only; not backend-api. Account catalog, storefalse/streamtrue, response.completed required.
inputarray and instructions/developer; explicit system and max_output_tokens/temperature/prompt_cache_retention unsupported. No persistent provider history.

verdict: Compatibility gap requiring a supported selected route and recorded request-shape qualification; not proof subscriptions impossible, not source implementation or permission to use a built-in OAuth flow.
